apps.name: StreamDock IPTV
apps.subtitle: Free, ad-free IPTV player
apps.localizedDescription: Free, ad-free IPTV player for Xtream Codes logins and M3U playlists, with a TV guide, catch-up, offline downloads, AirPlay and YouTube & Twitch.

versions.localizedDescription: New: YouTube & Twitch, data saver on mobile data, offline downloads of films/episodes, Chromecast from Android, in-app updates for the phone apps (Android installs the APK, iPhone via SideStore).

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: StreamDock connects to IPTV servers and AirPlay TVs on your local network.
